name: ISO 6983 metric G-code, Ketchup layout
sources: ISO 6983-1:2009 word-address format: G0/G1/G2/G3 with X Y Z, incremental I J arc centres, F feed, S speed, T tool with M6, M3/M5 spindle, M30 end, G21 millimetres, G90 absolute, G17 XY plane, G54-G59 work offsets.
The Ketchup records (plan, toolpath and simulation digests, feeds, safe height) are ';' comments, which the controller must accept; use a controller dialect when it does not.

motions.arc_clockwise: G2 X{x} Y{y} Z{z} I{i} J{j} F{feed} ;CUT_ARC
motions.arc_counterclockwise: G3 X{x} Y{y} Z{z} I{i} J{j} F{feed} ;CUT_ARC

name: FANUC milling (Series 0i/30i style), metric
sources: FANUC milling programming conventions: a program between '%' lines with an O program number, N sequence numbers, comments only in parentheses, G00/G01/G02/G03 with incremental I J arc centres, T M06 tool change, G43 H tool length compensation before the first Z move, M03/M05 spindle, M30 end.

FANUC reads an axis or feed value written without a decimal point in least input increments (0.001 mm on IS-B), so every X, Y, Z, I, J and F value is written with a decimal point and three decimals at most.
Older FANUC controls accept only upper-case letters, so the whole program, digests included, is upper case.

motions.arc_clockwise: G02 X{x} Y{y} Z{z} I{i} J{j} F{feed} (ARC)
motions.arc_counterclockwise: G03 X{x} Y{y} Z{z} I{i} J{j} F{feed} (ARC)

name: Grbl 1.1
sources: https://github.com/gnea/grbl/blob/master/README.md, 'List of Supported G-Codes in Grbl v1.1' (read 2026-11-16): G0, G1, G2, G3, G4, G17, G21, G40, G49, G54-G59, G80, G90, G94, M2, M3, M5, M30 and the words F I J P S T X Y Z.
M6 is not in that list, so Grbl cannot change a tool: the program names the tool in a comment and it must be in the spindle, touched off, before the start.
Grbl does not wait for the spindle to reach speed, so the program dwells three seconds (G4 P3, P in seconds) after M3.

motions.arc_clockwise: G2 X{x} Y{y} Z{z} I{i} J{j} F{feed} (ARC)
motions.arc_counterclockwise: G3 X{x} Y{y} Z{z} I{i} J{j} F{feed} (ARC)

name: LinuxCNC (RS274/NGC), metric
sources: https://linuxcnc.org/docs/html/gcode/overview.html (read 2026-11-16): a file that starts with a '%' line must end with one; M2 or M30 ends the program; comments in parentheses; at most 256 characters on a line; M6 T tool change; G43 tool length offset (modal group 8).
Arc centres I J are incremental, the RS274/NGC default (G91.1).

motions.arc_clockwise: G2 X{x} Y{y} Z{z} I{i} J{j} F{feed} (ARC)
motions.arc_counterclockwise: G3 X{x} Y{y} Z{z} I{i} J{j} F{feed} (ARC)
